title: INTRODUCTION
summary: Introduction to the 1970 Corvette Assembly Instruction Manual (AIM): it shows the final-assembly operations at the plant, is organized by UPC group (production) and by RPO option, and sheet letters (e.g. B2) mark areas of assembly within a group. No parts or fastening information.
notes: The manual shows the final assembly operations at the plant; insert revisions and remove superseded sheets promptly.
Sections (production and options) follow the uniform parts classification (UPC) groups; a contents sheet starts each section where needed.
Some sections are split by physical location in the vehicle; the sub-group letter prefixes the sheet number (e.g. Sheet B2).
Use the General Index for production sections and sub-groups, and the Option Index for regular production options (RPO).
The Option Index marks each option illustrated (assembles differently from production) or non-illustrated (assembles the same as production or a related option).
